## Full Course Description

Prime Agent Masterclass is an 8-module video course that teaches entrepreneurs, freelancers, and developers how to build and deploy autonomous AI agents using Prime Agent. The course covers installation, configuration, skills, sub-agents, marketing automation, sales automation, production deployment, and advanced topics.

Each module contains 5-6 video lessons with practical projects and templates. The course is available in Slovak and English.
